subject: Cognitive Science
title: How Babies Build Categories
description: A quick win: understand How Babies Build Categories.

hook.text: Show a baby ten different cats, then show a dog. The baby stares longer. It noticed the switch.

buildup.text: This looking-time trick lets researchers measure categorization in infants who cannot speak.

discovery.text: By three months, babies distinguish animals from vehicles. By ten months, cats from dogs.

twist.text: They do this without anyone teaching labels. Categories form from pure perceptual experience.

climax.text: Language later sharpens these boundaries, but the raw groupings come first.

quiz.question: How do researchers study categorization in infants?
options: By measuring how long babies look at new items
